summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K reporting the execution of the first tranche of an approved share buyback program. Between August 31 and September 4, 2026, purchases totaled €590,237,900.53, representing approximately 59.02% of the first tranche's maximum amount. HSBC Continental Europe acts as the buyback manager. This disclosure follows the July 30, 2026 inside-information notice and relates to the Board-approved program from July 29, 2026. The filing confirms ongoing capital return activities under European market-abuse regulations. What to watch: completion of the remaining 40.98% of the first tranche and any subsequent tranche announcements.
